# example

Example repo for the templates convention.

# Purpose

## What It Is

Example repo skeleton: che template rendering, `che.yml`, `.env` secrets, generated Makefile docs, agent files.

## Why It Exists

The templates convention needs a runnable reference, not a description of one.

## Goals

- Show the `che.yml` wiring for `.env.tpl` → `.env` and agent files.
- Show the `templates/` layout: `2-data`, `3-audience`.

## How To Use

`make render-templates` renders `*.ontoRepo.tpl` onto the repo: `.env` (op:// refs resolved), `assets/data/makefile.agents.md`, `assets/data/repo-structure.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`.

## Future Direction

Static example. Tracks the convention.
